name: Gemstone Lovers
source:
Welcome to the future! Well not far future and definitely not our current universe...But anyway! Have you heard the news?  The new planet that space explorers found was inhabited by  living gemstone people! Bijou! Thankfully they seemed peaceful enough and have even integrated into society well! 

Speaking of society, you recently moved out of your small village town to the city! Meeting all kinds of people and Bijou, it's a wonder you didn't become a geologist! 

[edited from [url=https://unusually-dead.itch.io/gemstone-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到未来！好吧，不远的未来，也绝对不是我们当前的宇宙……但无论如何！你听到这个消息了吗？太空探险家发现的新星球上居住着活生生的宝石人！宝石！值得庆幸的是，他们看起来足够平静，甚至已经很好地融入了社会！

说到社会，你最近从小镇搬到了城市！遇到各种各样的人和宝石，你没有成为地质学家真是奇迹！

[编辑自[url=https://unusually-dead.itch.io/gemstone-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
